compact-nxname.answer holds one DNS answer as received, the octets of
dnswire.Exchange's Response.Wire, kept as a sample of the compact "no such
name" form of RFC 9824.

Date:     11 Nov 2026, 12:49 UTC
Server:   jill.ns.cloudflare.com. at 173.245.58.122, port 53, over UDP;
          one of the two authoritative servers of ietf.org.
Question: nx-0aec20f873f3.ietf.org. IN A, a random label that does not
          exist; RD clear, DO set, EDNS(0) with UDP size 1232 and a client
          cookie.

answer saved here came 20 seconds after this one from dig, to the same
question:
